references.text: Describes the grain offering with oil and frankincense, the same elements mentioned in verse 15
Instructions to pour oil on the grain offering, parallel to the command regarding oil in verse 15
Mentions oil and frankincense as part of the grain offering, the same components as in the firstfruits offering
Contrast verse forbidding oil and frankincense on the sin offering, highlighting their significance in the grain offering
Describes incense (levona) and its holy use in worship
Contrast verse where oil and frankincense are omitted from the jealousy offering, highlighting their normal place in the grain offering
Establishes the general norm for ingredients (oil and frankincense) that the source verse confirms applies to all forms of grain offering.
